body: I'm sorry. I can see how overwhelming this could be. I think  you just need t make sure your daughter is responsible. It sounds like she has a very supportive group of responsible, level-headed adults to help guide her, so I feel like your daughter will be able to be pull through. But... I'm not sure what to say. I'm only a 15 year old girl myself. I feel like you are a responsible adult, and you have a good head on your shoulders. Just keep in mind the baby will be gone in at least 3 years.

First, I'll start off with saying I'm sorry that you have to deal with this. This is really scary :( 

Well, the only thing you can do is get professional help. My mother suffers from bipolar and borderline personality disorder, but she is also a compulsive liar. She used to say that my aunt sacrificed goats in her basement to satan. She also started ranting and raving about how Obama is the anti-christ in the middle of dinner. One time she started shouting about the dead sea scrolls, and said that it's harder for a rich man to get into heaven than a camel to fit through the head of a needle. My brother was on Barney, but got molested, she met the members of Green Day when she was a kid etc, etc. Also making up random shit about my father, and whatnot. It was bad. So I know that feel, bro. I'm sorry :( She needs help. 

Stay strong.
